name: Rizell Gardinia
original_name: リゼル・ガーディニア
source:
She is the princess of the Kingdom of Gardinia and she has a pure and gentle personality.

At her birthday party, Saga kidnaps her soul and puts it into an artificial body.

In order to maintain this homunculus body, she has no choice but to drink semen.

Told that she will die with this body when it dies, she reluctantly accepts drinking semen.

[Edited from Gyutto]
